facts.value: The Department of Economics offers the program Economic Chinese with conceptual support and guidance from the field of Sinology. This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a course for beginners with no prior knowledge.

facts.value: A1 (Basic Chinese) and A2 (Economic Chinese) according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.

facts.value: After completing the entire program, students should achieve an oral proficiency level near A1 of the GER.

facts.value: The aim of this course is to acquire basic vocabulary and to solidify knowledge of the basic structures of the Chinese language. After this course, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and manage typical everyday situations as well as tourist and professional stays in China independently.
